vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-before-closing-brace-is-unexpected-token-at-the-cr
vectors.comment: E-29: `a: 1`, a lone CR, `}`. The CR is not whitespace and not a newline, so it begins no token; the error is at the CR itself (1:5), not at the character after it (1:6), and it is unexpected-token, not trailing-content.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-after-colon
vectors.comment: E-29: a lone CR where a value is expected is not horizontal space and not a line break.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-between-edges
vectors.comment: E-29: a lone CR does not separate two edges; only LF, CRLF and `;` do.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/leading-lone-cr
vectors.comment: E-29: a lone CR at the very start of the document is rejected at 1:1.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-does-not-advance-the-line
vectors.comment: E-29: the CR is one column of line 2 and does not start line 3.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-after-a-comment-line-break
vectors.comment: E-29: a lone CR on a line of its own, after a comment's LF, is at 2:1.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-in-string-is-control-character
vectors.comment: E-29: a literal CR inside a string stays parse.control-character, positioned as any control character in a string is (the existing literal-control-character vector reports 1:4, the opening quote).

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/crlf-then-closing-brace-is-trailing-content
vectors.comment: E-29: CRLF is one line break, so the `}` is on line 2 and the document had already ended.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/lone-cr-inside-a-comment-is-comment-text
vectors.comment: E-29: a `#` comment runs to the next LF, so the CR and the `b: }` after it are comment text and the document is the one edge `a: 1`.

vectors.name: oml-grammar/lone-cr/crlf-line-breaks-are-accepted
vectors.comment: E-29: CRLF is one line break; its CR belongs to the line it ends.
